exercises.title: Rules catalogue 1 — static or dynamic?
exercises.problemHtml:
Each catalogued rule records whether it is static (unlikely to change) or dynamic (likely to change). Dynamic rules tell developers to make that functionality or data easy to update (e.g. configurable values).

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Luật tĩnh (ít đổi) hay động (dễ đổi) — luật động ⇒ làm phần đó dễ cập nhật.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Rules catalogue 3 — where did the rule come from?
exercises.problemHtml:
Business rules hide in: "common knowledge" of long-time staff; legacy systems (rules embedded in code); business-process models (constraints, triggers, computations at each step); document analysis (regulations, policies, contracts); data analysis; and the questions the BA asks during elicitation. Name the source of each discovery.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Luật nghiệp vụ ẩn ở đâu. Gọi tên nguồn của từng phát hiện.

Yêu cầu

exercises.title: Rules catalogue 2 — write catalogue entries
exercises.problemHtml:
Write CATALOG: three entries for these rules of a gym — (1) "A member under 16 may only book classes accompanied by an adult", (2) "A personal-training session costs 300,000 VND, or 250,000 VND for gold members", (3) "When a member has not paid for 30 days, the system suspends the membership". Each entry: { id, statement, type, staticOrDynamic, source } — id like BR-01, unique; type one of fact, constraint, action enabler, inference, computation; source names where the rule comes from (policy, law, manager, contract…).

Requirements

  • Types: (1) constraint, (2) computation, (3) action enabler.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Viết ba mục danh mục luật cho phòng gym, mỗi mục có id, phát biểu, loại, tĩnh/động, nguồn.

Yêu cầu

  • Loại: (1) constraint, (2) computation, (3) action enabler.

exercises.title: Rules catalogue 4 — where to store rules
exercises.problemHtml:
Manage rules as enterprise assets: a simple catalogue at first; a requirements tool storing rules as a requirement type for all projects; large or rule-heavy organisations may build a rules database, possibly with a rules engine. Rules touching safety, security, finance or compliance carry the greatest risk if unmanaged.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Quản lý luật như tài sản doanh nghiệp.

Yêu cầu

  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.
